title: hypr theme palette
description: Canonical color + bar-identity contract for a theme, read by the QML shell in quickshell/. Window chrome (gaps, borders, blur, shadow) stays in the same theme's theme.lua; this file never duplicates it.

hex.description: Opaque 6-digit hex. Alpha belongs to the consumer, not the palette.

name.description: Theme directory name. Must match the containing themes/<name>/ folder.

polarity.description: Matches theme.lua's polarity key. Dark is the default everywhere in this repo.

roles.description: The twelve semantic slots every shell surface draws from. Names come from the @define-color comments already at the top of each theme's waybar/style.css.

frame.description: THE identity color. Island edge, window border, notification edge.

readout.description: Every telemetry value on the bar. Kept visually apart from frame.

warn.description: Pending repo updates. Pac-Man stays yellow in every theme.

urgent.description: Low battery, overdue todos, offline network, auth failure.

dormant.description: Empty workspaces and zeroed counters — present but quiet.

launcher.description: The launcher's own hue — the one surface that covers the bar gets the one color the bar never uses.

surfaceAlt.description: Optional. A second raised shade for nested panels.

tokens.description: Upstream palette name -> role name. Documentation only; nothing reads it at runtime. Keeps a palette bump traceable back to its source project.

mono.description: Family name. Wants a Nerd Font for the bar glyphs.

sizeAccent.description: Clock and launcher glyph size, in px.

bar.description: Bar identity — the geometry that separates one theme's bar from another's (rounded glass vs. sharp CRT). Behavior lives in quickshell/settings.json instead.

color.description: Island fill. Often but not always `ground`.

opacity.description: Island alpha. The Hyprland layer rule frosts whatever shows through.

borderWidth.description: Hairline weight, in px. Drawn in `frame`.

borderOpacity.description: Alpha applied to `frame` for the island edge.

opacity.description: Alpha for a chip's own tinted backplate.

wallpaper.description: How the lock screen and the SDDM greeter treat this theme's wallpaper, so boot -> login -> lock read as one design.

brightness.description: hyprlock's brightness. The greeter uses (1 - brightness) as a scrim opacity.

^//.description: Prose comment. JSON has none, and these files carry rationale like every other file in this repo.
